name: cross_chunk
description: Per-chunk extraction (ENGINE_SPEC_v5 §2) may miss facts spanning a non-overlap chunk boundary. The chunker (~800/100) puts an ~100-char overlap between adjacent chunks; this fixture verifies that (a) a fact whose source span sits inside the overlap region is recoverable, and (b) when the fact is split outside the overlap, the verbatim floor (L0) still surfaces it via `via:'verbatim'` rather than honest-empty. The `extract.cross_chunk_suspected` logEvent (§18) instruments occurrences for monitoring.

expect.rationale: Even if the producing chunk straddled the 800-char boundary, the ~100-char overlap should let one chunk's extract lift the fact. If not, the verbatim floor (L0) must surface it via `via:'verbatim'` — never honest-empty.
